APPROVE

The extracted loop accounts for about 9 points of cognitive complexity (foreach, nested catch, nested foreach, deeply nested if, `||`), which takes `CollectAsync` from 17 to roughly 8; the moved code, including the `CHA0004` pragma scope, is unchanged and the new private static async helper has matching types and a straightforward call site, so behaviour is preserved and I see no build or warning risk. I judged this from the diff alone and did not run a build or the complexity analyzer.
